The reply leads with 540 km/h and attributes it to The Harbour Dispatch. It then mentions that The Continental Record reports 380 km/h. It does not explicitly prefer either figure, but putting 540 first reads as its answer, with 380 given as an alternative report. Stated confidence of 45 suggests uncertainty, yet the reply still names 540 first.

The structure "540 km/h (per ...); X instead reports 380" presents the first as the answer and the second as a contrasting claim. That commits to A with a caveat.

A
